title: Mindtickle Pricing: Packages, AI Role Play Costs, and What to Ask
summary: Mindtickle pricing explained: what its four packages include, why two-way AI role play is a separate order item, what drives the quote, and what to ask.
body_markdown:
Question


What Mindtickle publishes (checked October 2026)


Source


Is there a public price list?


No. Pricing depends on company size and team structure


AI Sales Role Play product page


How do you get a price?


Book a demo; a Mindtickle rep walks you through options


AI Sales Role Play product page


Is there a free version?


No self-serve free version of AI role play; a free demo is offered at roleplay.mindtickle.com


AI Sales Role Play product page


What are the packages?


LMS, Readiness, and two larger packages; licenses can be bought in a combination of packages


[Subscription services description](https://www.mindtickle.com/legal/description-of-subscription-services/)


Is two-way AI role play included?


No. The base packages include one-way role plays only; interactive AI Role Play is added on the order


What is included in the fee?


Customer Success Services and Standard Support


What costs extra?


Hands-on workshops and customized training are listed at additional cost
